ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a "COASTAL FOOD WEB" food web. On the left is Menhaden, and in the upper left is Striped Bass. An arrow can be seen from Menhaden to Striped Bass, indicating that striped bass eat menhaden. The other arrows in the image are also shown as going from food/prey to predator. Reasoning: If the number of striped bass increases, they will prey on more menhaden. Therefore, the number of menhaden will decrease.
